title: Africa's economic progress
questions: What are the main ideas you learned from this episode? Please give a brief summary in your own words.
When people talk about economic progress in Africa, what indicators should they look at besides GDP?
Why do international discussions sometimes treat Africa as if it were one single economy?
How important are infrastructure, education, and political stability for long-term growth?
Should foreign companies investing in African countries be expected to meet special local responsibilities?
What kind of economic progress matters most to ordinary people in their daily lives?
